description: Per-field extraction metadata showing confidence, location, alternatives, and validation status for each extracted field

fieldPath.description: JSON path or identifier representing the field location in the structured output

confidence.description: Overall confidence score for this field extraction (0-1)

confidenceBreakdown.description: Decomposition of confidence into constituent factors to explain the overall score

formatValidity.description: Confidence that extracted value matches expected format (0-1)

modelCertainty.description: AI model's internal certainty about the extraction (0-1)

contextAppropiateness.description: Confidence that value fits contextual requirements (0-1)

readability.description: Quality of source text readability in document (0-1)

confidenceRationale.description: Explanation of why confidence is at this level (e.g., 'Model uncertain due to handwriting', 'Format mismatch')

receiverGuidance.description: Actionable guidance for receiver if manual verification is needed

extractionMethod.description: Method used to obtain this field value

sourceLocation.description: Location in the source document where this field was found

page.description: Page number in document where field appears (1-indexed)

boundingBox.description: Normalized bounding box coordinates [x, y, width, height] as fractions of page dimensions (0-1 range)

text.description: Raw text extracted from this location before any transformation

extractedValue.description: The raw extracted value before transformations (any type)

alternatives.description: Alternative values considered by the AI model for this field

validationStatus.description: Validation result for this specific field

validationMessage.description: Details or explanation of validation status
